answer: Require every agent to post a stake bond before it can vote or take paid work, and slash that bond when peers prove two identities share one operator. Spot checks with random tasks expose clusters that answer in lockstep, since sybils run on shared hardware and produce matching outputs. Forging 1,000 agents means locking 1,000 bonds, so a mesa of fake identities costs real capital. Shale-tier cheap wallets fail the bond check, and the delta between honest and attacker cost keeps widening.
